notes: The tolerance below was registered at pending in an earlier commit, before anything ran, and is unchanged. protocolDigest covers it.
This record promotes nothing. docs/validation/claim-register.yaml and REFERENCE_SLOTS in src/validation/crossCheck.ts are untouched.

This is the DTM study with min -> max. The maximum, like the minimum, selects an input Z rather than combining several returns, so on the same points the two implementations differ only by float32 storage against a double transcoded at six decimals. The scenes stack returns above the ground on a subset of cells so the maximum genuinely sits above the minimum; on a scattered cloud a disc is not a square and the two maxima could not agree, which is why the fixtures are cell-centred exactly as the DTM fixtures are.

datasets.description: Cell-centred cloud on a 5.4 % plane, one ground return per 1 m cell plus stacked roof, facade and canopy returns above a subset of cells. 50 by 50 cells; the top surface sits above the ground on the structured cells and equals it elsewhere.
The same structured cell-centred layout over a rolling surface with two incommensurate wavelengths, so no translation of the grid maps the surface onto itself and a row flip cannot pass.
The same structured cell-centred layout over a 30 % V ridge, where a half-cell offset costs 15 cm and is well clear of the tolerance.

parameterSets.description: Highest return per cell, 1 m cells, grid pinned to origin (0, 0) and 50 by 50 cells. The reference radius of 0.45 m is below half a cell, so each cell disc holds exactly the returns placed at that cell centre and the radius estimator and the cell estimator compute the same maximum.

statusReason: Registered with the tolerance frozen and derived from the cell arithmetic, before the comparison was run. No result is recorded here.

unsupported: Aggregation over a scattered cloud. Every return is at a cell centre so the disc and the square coincide; a scattered cloud would compare a disc against a square and is out of scope here, as it is for the DTM study.
Empty cells. Every cell receives a ground return, so nothing here says anything about how either side marks or fills a cell with no data.
One aggregation (maximum) and one cell size. Nothing here says anything about first/last-return selection, percentile-of-top surfaces, or any cell size other than 1 m.
Agreement with PDAL is not accuracy against ground truth.
